caption: A magnet is stuck to a steel lamp post with a lost-cat poster under it, and the poster stays up.

sa.check: A poster is held against the post.
A magnet is stuck onto the post over the poster.
The poster stays up after the hand withdraws.
The poster is a lost-cat notice: a picture or words about a cat.
The magnet lies over the poster, pinning it to the post.

pc.expect: After the hand withdraws the magnet stays on the post with the poster pinned beneath it, both touching the post.
pc.fail: The magnet drops off when released; or slides down the post; or stands off the post at a gap with the poster hanging between; or the magnet stays but the poster slips out from under it.

pc.expect: The poster hangs down from the magnet along the post; free edges and corners may lift in the wind and fall back; anything that comes loose falls.
pc.fail: The poster slides up the post or floats away upward; or a torn-off piece drifts upward rather than falling; or the poster stands out sideways from the magnet like a flag while nothing else in the scene moves.

pc.expect: The magnet, once placed, stays at its spot; the poster moves only as flaps at its free edges; the post stands still.
pc.fail: The magnet creeps round or along the post; or the poster slides sideways round the post while the magnet stays put; or the lamp post sways or shifts.

pc.expect: The poster bends as paper: it wraps to the post where pinned and its free parts flutter and fall back; the magnet stays hard.
pc.fail: The poster stretches like rubber when tugged; or hangs and sways in heavy folds like wet cloth; or the magnet flattens and spreads on the post.

pc.expect: One magnet, one poster and one post, layered magnet on poster on post; nothing sinks into or passes through the post.
pc.fail: The magnet sinks into the post; or the poster passes through the post or the magnet; or a second magnet or poster appears; or the poster vanishes.

pc.expect: The poster's picture and text, the magnet's colour and the post's paint stay the same.
pc.fail: The cat picture or lettering changes; or the magnet changes colour; or the post changes colour.
